hero.title: Home Assistant AI Digest
hero.copy: Turn Home Assistant warnings, unavailable entities, stale sensors, and delivery failures into a private daily briefing you can act on.
hero.privacy: Secrets are sent only to the local backend and displayed as masks after validation.

manualDigest.title: Manual digest
manualDigest.copy: Run a scan with sensitive data masked now and queue the report without waiting for the next schedule.

history.title: No digests yet
history.copy: Your local history will show severity counts, delivery status, and report windows after the first run.

notes.title: Add a note
notes.copy: Attach maintenance windows or weird behavior so the next digest can explain what happened in context.

ignoredWarnings.title: Ignored warnings
ignoredWarnings.copy: Keep known noisy entities out of future digests without deleting the rule history.

telegramTest.title: Telegram test-send
telegramTest.copy: Send a safe test message through the stored notifier reference. Tokens stay masked.

settings.title: Daily schedule
settings.copy: Balanced privacy, 30-day retention, and daily plus weekly summary windows are ready to tune.
